summary_en: This Phase 1 study tests NEROFE given together with doxorubicin in people with advanced or metastatic solid tumors that have a KRAS mutation and ST2 expression. NEROFE is given into a vein weekly over 60 minutes at dose levels from 48 to 288 mg/m2, and doxorubicin is given weekly at a fixed 8 mg/m2 by intravenous push over 3 minutes. The main question is to find the recommended dose and schedule for the combination; the record does not state a specific outcome measure.
summary_es: Este estudio de Fase 1 evalúa NEROFE administrado junto con doxorrubicina en personas con tumores sólidos avanzados o metastásicos que tienen una mutación de KRAS y expresión de ST2. NEROFE se administra semanalmente por vena durante 60 minutos, en niveles de dosis de 48 a 288 mg/m2, y la doxorrubicina se administra semanalmente a una dosis fija de 8 mg/m2 por inyección intravenosa rápida durante 3 minutos. La pregunta principal es encontrar la dosis y el esquema recomendados para la combinación; el registro no indica una medida de resultado específica.
who_for: Advanced, unresectable, or metastatic solid tumor with a KRAS mutation.
Tumor shows ST2 expression on immunohistochemistry testing.
Progression or intolerance to standard therapies, with 2 or fewer lines of systemic therapy for advanced disease.
Measurable disease by RECIST 1.1 and disease amenable to serial core biopsies.
not_for: Anti-cancer therapy within 3 weeks before the first study dose, or active anti-cancer therapy during study treatment.
Brain metastases, unless previously treated and shown inactive on baseline MRI.
Active hepatitis B, hepatitis C, or HIV, with specified exceptions.
Significant heart disease, LVEF under 50%, or QTcF over 480 msec.
